title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-oke1: fuzz target references undefined DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT
description:
The fuzz target at rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs imports DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT from lichen_schc::fragment, but this constant is not defined anywhere in the crate. The fragment module (fragment.rs) has no definition or re-export of DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT. Both the fuzz target and tests/fragmentation.rs reference it, so this is a compile error in multiple files.

Additional note: The fragment.rs itself has 19 references to an undefined TILE_SIZE constant and 1 reference to an undefined tile_size variable (line 461), suggesting a broader refactoring-in-progress that hasn't been completed. But the scope of this commit (8dd65ab) is only the fuzz target, so the DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT issue is the review finding.
